scope: audit-only; not a canonical object ID, roster legality, or runtime relation

reviewedDeliveryPaths.summaryEvidence: Use [[skill:place-deployable|Place Deployable]] for ordinary no-Roll placement
reviewedDeliveryPaths.caveat: Uses shared Mine deployment with a Camouflage Marker and activation at Order Conclusion. The Cybermine attack is a Comms Attack opposed by Reset at -3 WIP, not ordinary Dodge; printed deployed-object S0 versus Army S1 remains disputed.

reviewedDeliveryPaths.delivery: Intuitive Attack WIP Roll for Camouflage Marker exception
reviewedDeliveryPaths.caveat: Required for an enemy CAMO Marker inside Trigger Area without a valid revealed enemy. Unmodified WIP; failure consumes a Disposable use and places no Mine. Distinct from the triggered Cybermine's Reset-only effect.

reviewedDeliveryPaths.summaryEvidence: [[skill:place-deployable|Place Deployable]] places one Token in Silhouette contact without a Roll
reviewedDeliveryPaths.caveat: Ordinary Silhouette-contact placement, not Perimeter delivery. Dazer's ZoC determines its Difficult Terrain effect area after activation; retain the unresolved S0 Army/detail versus S1 chart conflict.

reviewedDeliveryPaths.delivery: Place Deployable Skill with Perimeter positioning
reviewedDeliveryPaths.summaryEvidence: places a Scenery Element for Partial Cover
reviewedDeliveryPaths.caveat: Source-only S3 Scenery Element, not an Army four-stat profile. Position fully within the user's Zone of Control; declare only a Unit Profile-permitted Cutting Foam or Vitroferro variant. ARM/BTS/STR remain unreported.

reviewedDeliveryPaths.delivery: Place Deployable Skill with Perimeter positioning
reviewedDeliveryPaths.summaryEvidence: Crazykoalas use [[skill:place-deployable|Place Deployable]] without a Roll
reviewedDeliveryPaths.caveat: Perimeter placement is inside Zone of Control; Boost movement/detonation applies after activation. Shock/ARM profile is unique to Crazykoala, not WildParrot or Madtraps.

reviewedDeliveryPaths.delivery: Place Deployable Skill with Perimeter positioning
reviewedDeliveryPaths.summaryEvidence: Madtraps are [[trait:perimeter|Perimeter]] Weapons placed with [[skill:place-deployable|Place Deployable]] without a Roll
reviewedDeliveryPaths.caveat: Perimeter placement is inside Zone of Control; Boost after activation. PARA PH-6/Non-Lethal is separate from Crazykoala Shock or WildParrot E/M.

reviewedDeliveryPaths.delivery: Place Deployable Skill with Perimeter positioning
reviewedDeliveryPaths.caveat: Curated Trooper-profile object, not an Army Weapon-chart profile. Perimeter places it inside the user's Zone of Control. S1/S2 chart/detail discrepancy remains unresolved.

reviewedDeliveryPaths.delivery: Place Deployable Skill with Perimeter positioning
reviewedDeliveryPaths.caveat: No placement Roll; Perimeter positions the object inside the user's Zone of Control rather than in Silhouette contact. Activation begins at Order Conclusion.

reviewedDeliveryPaths.delivery: Intuitive Attack WIP Roll with Perimeter positioning
reviewedDeliveryPaths.summaryEvidence: A legal [[skill:intuitive-attack|Intuitive Attack]] instead uses an unmodified WIP Roll
reviewedDeliveryPaths.caveat: Unlike ordinary Place Deployable, an Intuitive Attack uses an unmodified WIP Roll; a failure places no object and consumes the Disposable (1) use.

reviewedDeliveryPaths.delivery: Place Deployable Skill with Perimeter positioning
reviewedDeliveryPaths.summaryEvidence: Declare [[skill:place-deployable|Place Deployable]] to place it fully inside
reviewedDeliveryPaths.caveat: Place Deployable requires no Roll; the stationary Repeater becomes active at Order Conclusion. Do not infer Boost behavior.
